claim_type: rigorous disproof of universal conjunction (TARGET resolution via inversion conjunct)
limitations: Disproof targets the universal conjunction via the inversion conjunct on the round metric; it does not decide injectivity for non-round projective Finsler metrics, does not rule out pseudodifferential (order +1, sqrt-Laplacian type) inversion, and uses SO(3)-equivariance specific to the round case.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment pending.
record_title: No universal differential Santaló inversion for the projective Finsler X-ray on RP^2: round metric is injective but D I^*I = Id has no finite-order differential solution
